title: What If a Locust Swarm Hit Your Town?
subject: desert locust swarm

scenes.text: What if locusts landed on your town? The sky goes dark first.
A swarm just one square kilometer wide can hold up to 80 million adult locusts.
Each locust eats about its own weight every day. That swarm eats as much as 35,000 people.
And it moves. Riding the wind, a swarm can travel up to 150 kilometers in a single day.
In 2020, one swarm in northern Kenya covered about 2,400 square kilometers, roughly the size of Luxembourg.
Swarms like that hit 23 countries, from East Africa to Pakistan. Nothing green was safe.
